maddeler.e:
انقرأت (form VII)
# اِنْقَرَأْتُ (inqaraʔtu) /in.qa.raʔ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْقَرَأَ (inqaraʔa)
# اِنْقَرَأْتَ (inqaraʔta) /in.qa.raʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْقَرَأَ (inqaraʔa)
# اِنْقَرَأْتِ (inqaraʔti) /in.qa.raʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْقَرَأَ (inqaraʔa)
# اِنْقَرَأَتْ (inqaraʔat) /in.qa.ra.ʔat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
